profile_text.body:
Dropbox is a for-profit public company founded in 2007 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. It provides secure cloud storage, file sharing, and collaboration tools, and its own site describes the platform as enabling users to organize company content in one place through a product called Dash. The site also highlights support for previews of 175+ file types and synced team folders as part of its core offering.

On the AI side, Dropbox offers a product called Dropbox AI, categorized under notes, knowledge, and meetings, which the company describes as covering document summaries, team data management, and sharing controls. The site notes that Dropbox connects with leading AI platforms to summarize content, create shared links, and save work back to Dropbox without switching tools, and describes built-in AI summaries as coming soon. A third-party MCP server, ai.smithery/cindyloo-dropbox-mcp-server, is listed in the registry and enables searching, browsing, and reading Dropbox files by name or content.

Dropbox trades on a public exchange under the ticker DBX and carries the SEC CIK 0001467623. Its most recently reported annual revenue, drawn from a 10-K filing for the period ending December 31, 2025, was $2,521,000,000. No litigation exposure is recorded in the held facts.
